title: Fire
build: MAME's ROM set gnw_fire: fr-27, the Sharp SM5A's mask ROM of the Wide Screen Fire (FR-27), 1,856 bytes, CRC32 f4c53ef0, SHA-1 6b57120a0f9d2fd4dcd65ad57a5f32def71d905f, as MAME 0.289 lists it

tools.emulator: the kit's Sharp SM5A (kit/gnw/sm5a.js) in the kit's server (kit/gnw/gnw_server.mjs), held to MAME 0.289 instruction for instruction; check-emulator 9 passed, 0 failed, on 25 November 2026
tools.disassembler: kit/cpu/sm5a.py, with the control file kit/gnw/project.py reads (work/fire.ctl)
tools.host: macOS 27.0.1 on Apple silicon (a Mac mini)
tools.browser: Google Chrome (the Mac's own), for the reference pictures

accuracy.note: the Super Mario Wiki, Arcade History and MAME 0.289's driver block, on 25 November 2026; the same day Nintendo's "Iwata Asks: Game & Watch", SmashWiki, Wikipedia and three photographs from Wikimedia Commons for the page's history
a fresh agent; the same mistakes corrected where facts.md, features.md and other comments repeated them (the best scores' cells, the divider's rate, the click)
